description: This file defines a custom Orleans grain class 'CustomDirectoryGrain' implementing the 'ICustomDirectoryGrain' interface, with methods for pinging, resetting, and retrieving runtime instance ID, and uses Orleans attributes for grain directory configuration.

classes.name: CustomDirectoryGrain
classes.description: A custom Orleans grain class that manages a grain directory with methods for pinging, resetting, and retrieving the silo address.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Returns an incremented counter value asynchronously.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counter to zero asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the silo address asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Calls the Ping method on another grain implementing ICommonDirectoryGrain.
